title: review-backend-code input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage backend-review.

files_generated.description: Shape: implement-backend-feature schemas/output.json#/properties/files_generated. Production files emitted by step 4. At least one entry. Empty array is invalid — a Generate stage that emits no files must signal loop_back instead.

tests_generated.description: Shape: implement-backend-feature schemas/output.json#/properties/tests_generated. Companion test files emitted by step 5. At least one entry — banking-grade Generate never emits production without tests.

api_contracts.description: Shape: designing-tech-lead-handoff schemas/output.json#/properties/api_contracts. Verbatim shape of templates/tech-lead-contracts.md embedded schema. These are the cross-component INTERFACE contracts (the architecture's connective tissue), NOT per-service endpoint specs. payload_shape is intentionally open (free-form JSON-Schema-ish object per the template).

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
